author: Marek Bajbar
why: Source identifies Loxodonta africana. Standing elephant, grassy savanna and cloudy sky provide a classic habitat composition; original dimensions were not exposed.

author: Florian Kriechbaumer
why: Classic savanna elephant composition with Kilimanjaro behind; documented camera photograph, 2699 × 1852. Sex unconfirmed; landscape composition needs careful portrait cropping.

author: chris clark
why: 4397 × 2473 original. Source identifies Loxodonta africana in Kenya’s savanna; isolated animal and natural grassland setting suit a poster crop.

author: Advik Mehta
why: Explicitly identified male tusker crossing open grassland in Amboseli, Kenya. One tusk is broken; native dimensions and crop suitability unverified.

author: Datingscout
why: Photographer identifies a large wild elephant walking in Botswana’s Okavango Delta; green grassland setting. Sex, native dimensions and 9:10 crop suitability unverified.

author: Maysam Yabandeh
why: Caption explicitly identifies an adult male Loxodonta africana with large tusks in natural savanna. Linked preview is 1344 × 1012; page offers a 2953 × 2224 original.

author: Maysam Yabandeh
why: Explicit African bush elephant identification and natural shrubland setting; camera metadata supports photographic origin. Linked preview is 1344 × 1012; page offers a 4080 × 3072 original.

author: Cyndi Perry/USFWS
why: 3859 × 2563 original explicitly captioned African savanna elephant in Pilanesberg National Park. Strong identification and unrestricted licence; the download timed out during verification.

author: momathew
why: Caption explicitly identifies Umoja, a large male Loxodonta africana in Selenkay. Strong adult-bull alternative; supplied 1024px size and watermark status could not be independently verified.

author: Maysam Yabandeh
why: Source identifies Loxodonta africana on savanna at sunset, offering warmer colour. Wide composition needs careful cropping; linked preview is 1344 × 756, with a 3347 × 1883 original offered.

author: Munib Chaudry
why: Caption confirms a fully grown African bush elephant bull photographed early morning in Amboseli. Excellent subject match; supplied 1024px size and watermark status could not be independently verified.
